Lemma
[Escape Lemma] 1. chA:A.43Suppose $M$ is a smooth manifold and $X \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$. If $\gamma : I \to M$ is a maximal integral curve of $X$ whose domain $I$ has a finite least upper bound $b$, then for every $t_0 \in I$, $\gamma ([t_0, b))$ is not contained in any compact subset of $M$.
